prose: DealStreetAsia reports Beijing's Sand.ai, a video-generation startup, raised a $200M Series A+ at a valuation above $1B, making it a unicorn. CoStone Capital and Wangsu Science & Technology led, joined by state-owned Pudong Venture Capital and an arm of Shanghai International Group, with existing investors iMPC, CAS Star and HyT re-upping. It is the third round of 2026 and brings 10-month funding to $300M, less than five months after over $100M across two rounds.
highlights: Led by CoStone Capital and Wangsu
Third round of 2026; $300M in ten months
